sampleDefinition: Reconstruct sample timestamps by cumulative V8 timeDeltas, sort them, attribute each sample until the next timestamp, clip to begin/end. Values are sample leaf estimates, not measured function intervals. Also intersect those estimated segments with the renderer-main RunTask union. Sorting removes overlap from negative deltas; this matches the repaired sampledProfile forward weighting. First sample gaps are uncovered; final sample receives zero tail without a subsequent timestamp. Both captured profiles start before and end after the measured window, so the existing classification needs no numeric adjustment.

raf.exactContainmentStatus: Incomplete correlation; use source-identified FunctionCall group count and duration difference for scheduler envelope.
raf.durationDifferenceScope: Source-identified render callback FunctionCall duration minus measured drawFrame/renderRows duration. Includes recorder overhead, caller bookkeeping, browser callback entry/exit, and GC; not pure scheduler time.

raf.exactContainmentStatus: Incomplete correlation; use source-identified FunctionCall group count and duration difference for scheduler envelope.
raf.durationDifferenceScope: Source-identified render callback FunctionCall duration minus measured drawFrame/renderRows duration. Includes recorder overhead, caller bookkeeping, browser callback entry/exit, and GC; not pure scheduler time.

intervalDefinition: Instrumented spans use performance.now. Builder and parser are inclusive synchronous call intervals, including native work and caller-side wrapper work where noted. Do not add nested intervals, rAF callback envelopes, or sample estimates to the measured partition.
limitations: Not controlled timing: traces enable broad GPU/V8 categories plus tracing and API-count wrappers. Do not compare perturbed totals or project shares onto independent renderer CPU figures.
No separate bridge_build_frame interval exists. Wasm export index and ancestry permit only sampled native-descendant attribution.
Callback readRows is measured, emitFrame and onFrame/onRowsPainted downstream UI are not individually instrumented.

Recorded FunctionCall groups identify each render scheduler callback. FireAnimationFrame correlations in raf.ownedCount are incomplete under exact containment and must not be reported as total terminal callback count; callbackGroups contains the authoritative 5117 group count.

Sample estimates reconstruct and sort negative-delta timestamps then weight until the next sample. Program, idle and GC leaves have no useful library ancestry; native-call sampling is not uniformly spaced. Main-task intersection is an attribution estimate, not CPU accounting.

WebGPU command submit span excludes acquisition of getCurrentTexture/createView and buffer uploads; xterm only wraps drawElementsInstanced and flush at the command stage. Neither measures GPU-device execution.

analysisImplementation.sampleScope: Timestamp-sorted forward leaf weights intersected with merged renderer-main RunTask intervals; unsampled edges remain explicit. Sample weights are estimates and overlap parent wrapper intervals.
